definitions.explanation: The fruit of the apple tree. A popular fruit in Japan, often given as gifts.

examples.japanese: りんごを{一|ひと}つください。
{青森|あおもり}のりんごは{有名|ゆうめい}です。
examples.notes: Aomori Prefecture is the top apple-producing region in Japan

notes: りんご can also be written in kanji as {林檎|りんご}, though hiragana is more common. {青森県|あおもりけん} in northern Japan is famous for its apple production. {りんご{飴|あめ}} (candy apple) is a popular festival food.
